summary.text: Julie Jarvis is a Republican member of the Wyoming House of Representatives for District 57 who took office in January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
She faces Democrat Luc Colgrove in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Julie Jarvis earned a bachelor's degree and a graduate degree from the University of Bridgeport in 2000 and 2001 and a Ph.D. from the University of Connecticut in 2018.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as a director and her affiliations as The Reading League Wyoming and the American Legion Auxiliary.
Jarvis assumed office on January 6, 2025, succeeding Jeanette Ward.

For 2025-2026 she chaired the House Journal Committee and the Joint Journal Committee and was assigned to the House Travel, Recreation, Wildlife and Cultural Resources Committee and the Air Transportation Liaison Committee.
She defeated Ward in the August 18, 2026 Republican primary, 57.5% to 41.6%.
